findings: 2026-11-06: drafted for Mathematics 12 Unit 9 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.
Book correction: The book prints "define by"; it should read "defined by": the function f : \mathbb{R} \to [-1, 1] defined by f(x) = \cos x.

Book correction: The book prints "is also obtain by reflecting"; it should be "is also obtained by reflecting". It also prints "Observe that the graph of y = \cos x is symmetric about the line y = x". The graph of y = \cos x alone is not symmetric about y = x; the correct statement is that the graphs of y = \cos x (principal) and y = \cos^{-1} x are symmetric about the line y = x (mirror images of each other).
